clause: Variable fonts (axes + named instances + variable binding) [STU-TYP-019]

scope.summary: Support OpenType variable fonts: expose each font's registered and custom design axes (weight wght, width wdth, optical size opsz, slant slnt, italic ital, and arbitrary custom axes) as continuous per-range controls producing arbitrary instances, and expose the font's predefined named instances for one-click selection. Axis values are stored on the character range and MAY be bound to a StudioVariable (number) for token-driven typography (group 8 / 14.10). Operator axis sliders + model command.
acceptance_criteria: registered+custom axes continuous per-range; named instances; StudioVariable binding for tokens
expected_tests: live: registered + custom axes as continuous per-range sliders producing arbitrary instances; named instances one-click
test: axis value bindable to StudioVariable (number)

risk_if_missed: No variable-font support; modern type + token-driven weight/width unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
